title: Position Update
description: Compact advisory Position Update output. All user-facing text values MUST be written in Indonesian. Current price and confirmed position facts remain user-owned and authoritative.

update_summary.description: Concise summary of the current position update in Indonesian.

current_price.description: Echo of the user-entered current price for display; it is not inferred by Gemini.

position_condition.description: Concise Indonesian assessment of the existing position; it does not change position facts.

orderbook_assessment.description: Concise assessment of the latest orderbook in Indonesian.

change_from_previous_analysis.description: Concise Indonesian description of material change from earlier analysis.

target_realism.description: Concise advisory Indonesian assessment of whether the confirmed target remains realistic; it does not replace the target.

downside_risk.description: Concise advisory downside-risk assessment in Indonesian.

target_probability.description: Advisory probability of reaching the confirmed target from 0 to 100.

trading_plan.description: Concise advisory plan in Indonesian; it does not execute CLOSE or modify position facts.

monitoring_points.description: Concise items to monitor in Indonesian.

conclusion.description: Concise final advisory assessment in Indonesian.
